player_0.content: New plan: I repeatedly used the incorrect command "move subst to table" because I misunderstood the specific syntax required for moving objects. The game requires the format "> [object] [preposition] [location]" (e.g., "> subst on table"). I failed to notice that the object name "subst" is an abbreviation for "substance" and that the preposition "to" is not valid for placing items; I must use "on" instead. My new plan is to first open the wardrobe to access the book if needed, then use the correct command "> subst on table", followed by "> book on scont", and finally "> plate on scont". I will verify the exact spelling of "substance" and "scront" (or "scront" as given) before executing the moves.
